module.purpose: This file resolves organization-scoped user routes by checking whether the requested slug identifies a child team, then delegates server-side rendering to the appropriate team or user page handler.
module.summary: The file acts as a routing adapter for organization-scoped dynamic pages. It reads the organization and user route parameters, queries Prisma for a matching child team within the organization, and forwards the request to either the team page or the user page server-side props handler while preserving relevant redirect parameters.
module.businessContext: Supports multi-tenant organization URLs where a slug may represent either a team or an individual user. Failure can route visitors to the wrong profile or prevent organization pages from rendering.
functions: getServerSideProps (~L10-40): Resolves organization context and delegates rendering to team or user page handlers.

io: Reads the database for the first child team matching the requested user slug and organization.

contractsConsumed.name: prisma.team.findFirst
contractsConsumed.shape: prisma.team.findFirst({ where: { slug: ctx.query.user as string, parentId: { not: null }, parent: getSlugOrRequestedSlug(ctx.query.orgSlug as string) }, select: { id: true } })

contractsConsumed.name: GSSTeamPage
contractsConsumed.shape: GSSTeamPage({ ...ctx, query: { slug: ctx.query.user, ...(ctx.query.orgRedirection !== undefined && { orgRedirection: ctx.query.orgRedirection }) } })

contractsConsumed.name: GSSUserPage
contractsConsumed.shape: GSSUserPage({ ...ctx, query: { user: ctx.query.user, ...(ctx.query.redirect !== undefined && { redirect: ctx.query.redirect }), ...(ctx.query.orgRedirection !== undefined && { orgRedirection: ctx.query.orgRedirection }) } })

sectionMap.name: getServerSideProps
sectionMap.intent: Asynchronously resolves a team or user server-side page.

sectionMap.name: team lookup
sectionMap.intent: Finds the first matching child team in the requested organization.

sectionMap.name: team routing

edgeCases.inputShape: A matching team exists with a non-null parentId.
edgeCases.behavior: Delegates to GSSTeamPage using ctx.query.user as slug and optionally preserves orgRedirection.

edgeCases.inputShape: No matching team exists, including a matching team with parentId null.
edgeCases.behavior: Delegates to GSSUserPage and passes user, plus optional redirect and orgRedirection.
Omits orgRedirection from the delegated query.

edgeCases.inputShape: redirect is absent for user-page routing.
edgeCases.behavior: Omits redirect from the delegated user query.

edgeCases.inputShape: user or orgSlug is missing or has an unexpected query value shape.
edgeCases.behavior: Casts the values to string without validation and passes them to the database lookup.

assumptions.description: ctx.query.user and ctx.query.orgSlug are usable as string slugs.
The team record exposes id and supports parentId and parent filtering.
GSSTeamPage and GSSUserPage accept the reconstructed server-side props contexts.

ambiguities.question: What behavior do Prisma lookup failures or delegated page-handler failures produce?
How do downstream handlers interpret non-string or array-valued query parameters?

moduleContractTests.scenario: When the requested user slug identifies a child team in the requested organization, the team page handler is invoked.
given: ctx.query.user as string matches a team slug
the team has a non-null parentId
the team parent matches getSlugOrRequestedSlug(ctx.query.orgSlug as string)
moduleContractTests.then: GSSTeamPage is called with query.slug set to ctx.query.user and orgRedirection forwarded when defined
moduleContractTests.rationale: Guards organization team routes from being handled as user pages.

moduleContractTests.scenario: When no matching child team is found, the request is delegated to the user page handler.
moduleContractTests.then: GSSUserPage is called with query.user set to ctx.query.user, while redirect and orgRedirection are forwarded only when defined
moduleContractTests.rationale: Preserves fallback user-page routing and conditional query propagation.

units.name: getServerSideProps

detail.name: getServerSideProps
preconditions: ctx provides a query object containing orgSlug and user values used to construct the lookup and delegated page context.
postconditions: Performs a team lookup using the requested user slug, a non-null parentId, and the organization slug resolved by getSlugOrRequestedSlug.
If a matching team exists, returns the result of GSSTeamPage with the original context and a query containing slug and, when supplied, orgRedirection.
If no matching team exists, returns the result of GSSUserPage with the original context and a query containing user and any supplied redirect and orgRedirection values.
invariants: The original context is spread into the context passed to the delegated page handler.
The team branch does not forward redirect.
The user branch does not forward orgSlug.
edgeCases: When the team lookup returns a truthy team record, GSSTeamPage is selected and only the selected team id is requested from the database.
When the team lookup returns no team, GSSUserPage is selected.
When orgRedirection is undefined, it is omitted from the delegated query in either branch.
When redirect is undefined, it is omitted from the delegated user-page query.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback is performed; errors from query processing, getSlugOrRequestedSlug, Prisma, or the delegated page handler propagate.

detail.summary: Determines whether the requested user slug identifies a child team within the requested organization. It delegates server-side rendering to the team page when a matching team exists, otherwise to the user page, preserving the applicable query parameters.

specTests.then: The result is the result of GSSTeamPage called with the original context fields and query { slug: ctx.query.user, orgRedirection: ctx.query.orgRedirection }.
The result is the result of GSSUserPage called with the original context fields and query { user: ctx.query.user, redirect: ctx.query.redirect, orgRedirection: ctx.query.orgRedirection }.
The corresponding undefined query properties are omitted from the query passed to GSSUserPage.
